storyCards.headline: Let's Get It On: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Marvin Gaye's "Let's Get It On" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "Marvin Gaye's Greatest Hits" (1964) — not the song's original release year.

Album: Marvin Gaye's Greatest Hits (1964).

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
